Bone Density Screening Information (Fiscal Year 2026)

【Who can attend】
Women aged 40, 45, 50, 55, or 60 (turning that age by March 31, 2027)

【Cost】
300 yen

【What's included】
• Ultrasound bone density measurement
• Explanation of your results
• Talk on nutrition for bone health

【What to wear】
Please wear clothing that makes it easy to go barefoot, since we'll use ultrasound on your heels.

【Screening dates and times】
• Friday, October 2 — afternoon — Hanno Health Center — capacity 165 people (first come, first served)
• Saturday, October 3 — morning — Hanno Health Center — capacity 165 people (first come, first served)

【How to apply】

First round of applications: August 3 (Monday) – August 17 (Monday), must arrive by deadline
• Apply by: electronic application, postcard, or fax (042-974-6558)
• Screening voucher will be sent around late August

Second round of applications: Only held if first round doesn't fill capacity. September 3 (Thursday) – must arrive 10 days before your screening date
• Apply by: reservation phone (042-974-3471, weekdays 9:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.), electronic application, postcard, or fax (042-974-6558)
• Screening voucher will be sent around 9 days before your screening date

Applications are processed first come, first served. We encourage you to apply early. Eligible residents received an invitation letter in late July.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/7930.html
